value.body: A QA engineer tests software to find bugs and writes automated tests so new releases work as expected. IT services firms, product companies and startups hire them. A day involves reading requirements, writing test cases, running manual and automated tests, logging bugs and checking fixes.

items.label: India tech industry workforce
items.note: Direct employees across all tech roles, not only QA; ~1.3 lakh net additions in the year

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers join through campus placement or off-campus drives as trainee testers or QA engineers. Many start with manual testing and move into automation; learning one programming language and one automation tool improves chances.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Writing test cases and test plans
Test automation with a scripting language
Understanding of the software development lifecycle

value.title: At a glance
items: Automation skills are increasingly expected even at entry level.
Common next roles: SDET, senior QA or test lead, performance or security tester.
Some testers move into development or DevOps roles later.

value.title: BCA enrolment, regular mode
value.note: Regular mode only; BCA is one of several routes into QA. Based on institutions that responded to the survey; part of the year-to-year change reflects response coverage.

competition.note: B.Tech / B.E. (all branches) graduates in 2023-24 at institutions that reported to AISHE — everyone finishing that degree, not only those entering this role.
